items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He wrote me a letter. He said, I'm going to come to New York and teach you how to play. So we met in the Savoy after we got through and went to the Rhythm Club.

ctx.x: He wrote me a letter. He said, I'm going to come to New York and teach you how to play. So we met in the Savoy after we got through and went to the Rhythm Club. So I wasn't showing off, just took out the horn and started playing ... There wasn't nobody there playing but him. They left him in there by himself.

Was that the time when came T6 over and played with you? ... He was playing the Brass Rail T7 in Chicago and when he and Red finished there they came to Cleveland. He and Red came to Cleveland and Red went on to New York and Jay stayed there with me.
